Game Arcade

Slice & Stone: Pizza Chef

Browser build · Godot Engine
🍕 SLICE & STONE

A cozy pizzeria management game — prep, bake, serve, don't burn it.

playable in-browser ▶ Play Now

A fast-paced kitchen sim where every slice, toss, and stone-oven bake runs on real-time timing. Read the order, prep the pizza, watch the bake bar, and get it to the customer before they walk.

  • ▹ Drag-and-drop prep counter: dough → sauce → cheese → toppings
  • ▹ Bake-timing mechanic — raw, perfect, overcooked, burnt
  • ▹ Level select, in-game shop, unlockable characters, autosave
